title: Templates for Complex Components and Structures
objective: Recognise how more complex component, structural and CNC-related template information is controlled by approved drawings, dimensions, specifications and job references.
safety_boundary: Learning only. This lesson develops recognition and understanding. It does not authorise practical marking-out, cutting, forming, welding, machine operation, CNC programming or fabrication.

sections.heading: What makes a template more complex?
sections.body: A complex template may represent a component or structure with several connected surfaces, changes in shape, offsets, transitions, intersections or repeated features.

sections.heading: Complex-component templates
sections.body: Complex-component templates can represent information for components whose shapes cannot be understood reliably from a simple outline alone.

sections.heading: Structural templates
sections.body: Structural templates may relate to members, connections, openings or interfaces within a larger structure. Their identity must remain connected to the intended component, location and controlled job reference.

sections.heading: CNC-related template information
sections.body: Digital or CNC-related information used to represent profiles and component geometry remains controlled information and must correspond with the approved drawing, specification, file identity and revision.

sections.heading: Drawing interpretation
sections.body: Complex templates may depend on several drawing views, symbols, dimensions, notes and references. Confirm the correct drawing and revision.

sections.heading: Related layout calculations
sections.body: Calculations associated with laying out complex, structural and CNC-related templates must come from approved dimensions and methods and be checked against controlled job information.

questions.question: Why does complex template work require careful control of identity, orientation and revision?
options: Because more complex geometry can depend on several connected pieces of controlled information
Because any template that looks similar can be used
questions.answer: Because more complex geometry can depend on several connected pieces of controlled information

questions.question: What remains the authority for a complex or structural template?
options: The current approved drawing, specification and controlled job information
questions.answer: The current approved drawing, specification and controlled job information

questions.question: What should happen if template information conflicts with the current drawing or revision?
options: Continue with the template that appears closest
Stop and clarify through the responsible process
questions.answer: Stop and clarify through the responsible process
